scope: English README, documentation, explanatory HTML/JSON and art-authoring notes, plus two supplied development screenshots.

method.primary_documents: Manually written or translated and compared with source records.
method.historical_archive: Offline NLLB-200 contextual translation with exact restoration and validation of protected code, paths, identifiers and numeric literals; followed by focused editorial checks.
method.original_wording: Retained in the baseline import commit. The original source-snapshot manifest is unchanged and remains historical.
method.translated_documentation_placeholders: Directory, sample save filename, host-address placeholders and one rendering-diagram label were translated. Actual localized runtime and Unicode-test literals were preserved.

preserved.legacy_document_filenames: Preserved to keep existing paths stable

validation.full_build_or_full_ctest: Not run for this documentation-only update
validation.screenshots: User-supplied visual examples; no fresh runtime capture or performance evidence

limitations: Historical build and acceptance records apply only to their named snapshots.
Some historical links reference local evidence excluded from the public source import.
Exact localized UI/error examples remain multilingual where they document runtime behavior.
Public visibility does not add code or asset reuse rights; existing notices remain applicable.
